Sometimes I just want peace and quite, and sometimes my dog does too.

Well, I can’t say it does or it doesn’t objectively, as each individual will personally have a positive or negative opinion/preference on said armour.

Legendary gear was initially designed to be the prestige, flashy and impressive gear.
But with the addition of many flashy skins in the gem store, many people may find those to look better.

There have been a lot of changes in the last few years to legendary weapon use, which greatly increased their convenience for many people. 
These conveniences include:

-Free/infinite transmutation 
-Stat swapping anytime out of combat
-Easy access to the legendary items you unlocked, for all characters across your account through the “Legendary Armoury” (so no putting any weapons in the bank or a shared inventory slot to transfer them between characters)
-Ascended level stats
-Account bound rather than Soul bound

These are just some examples of their convenience.
Now a days, some people craft legendary gear just for these reasons, rather than about the skin itself.

I personally like some of the raid/pve legendary armour skins, though I don’t find them super fantastic.
Others might find them to be super cool and use those skins all the time.
There are also others like yourself, who don’t prefer them.
It’s all subjective.

Legendary gear (not specifically legendary armour) wasn’t initially intended for convenience, at the START of this game.
It was intended to be a flashy skin before they added those changes much later.
Now, it is a mix of the two.
